prompt: Professional premium rigid packaging photography, one CONSISTENT product in a strict 3-column 2-row contact sheet, 3:2 overall. Six equal square cells, no borders/captions/text/logo. Cell6 blank. Product Family supplement pairing, Lift-off lid. A completely removable shallow cap fits over a four-wall base. Paper-wrapped rigid greyboard, Textured uncoated wrapping paper, Coral and midnight blue, Fine foil lines and offset pattern, fine abstract wave pattern. EMPTY insert: two different-size bottle cavities. Cell1 CLOSED full 3/4 hero. Cell2 OPEN: In the open view place the detached lid flat to the RIGHT of the base with a wide visible gap. No hinge or spine. Cell3 closed rear/side same design. Cell4 overhead close view of the SAME empty insert inside base. Cell5 close paper/finish/corner detail. All views same proportions, artwork locations, number and shape of insert cavities. Neutral warm studio, tactile paper, refined controlled lighting. Never a corrugated mailer, tuck carton, dust flaps or shipping box. Realistic separate assembled rigid walls, straight edges, accurate mating footprints and visible paper thickness. Keep complete objects within each cell. No products inside; focus on the packaging. In detachable structures never prop the lid against the base or stand it behind it; rest it flat alongside with a clear empty gap.
reviewNotes: Five views visually reviewed for opening, insert layout and finish continuity; physical sampling still required.
